# I-Pack Auto Parts

> Guangzhou I-Pack Auto Parts Co., Limited operates an English-language B2B inquiry website for aftermarket auto lights and body parts for Japanese and Asian vehicles.

The website is designed for wholesale RFQ, OE-number matching, vehicle fitment checks and export sourcing. It does not collect online payment. Buyers can build a multi-product inquiry list or contact Sales Director Lynda Yang at [lynda.yang@ipackauto.com](mailto:lynda.yang@ipackauto.com) and [WhatsApp +86 18620780862](https://wa.me/8618620780862).

## Product discovery

- [Product catalog](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/products): Browse the current wholesale catalog of headlights, tail lights, fog and corner lights, mirror covers, wheel covers and related body parts.
- [OE number search](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/oe-number-search): Find product pages by OE or part number.
- [Vehicle search](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/vehicle-search): Browse compatible parts by vehicle make and model.
- [Product categories](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/categories/japanese-auto-body-parts-supplier): Review the main product families supplied by I-Pack.

## RFQ and buyer support

- [Inquiry list](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/quote-list): Build one RFQ containing multiple products and quantities.
- [Contact and RFQ](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/contact): Send vehicle, OE number, quantity, destination and contact details for a quotation.
- [Fitment FAQ](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/faq): Review the information buyers should provide before fitment confirmation and quotation.
- [OEM and ODM service](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/oem-odm-service): Learn about custom product and private-label inquiry support.

## Sourcing guidance

- [Auto parts RFQ guide](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/blog/auto-parts-rfq-guide-for-importers): Prepare a complete wholesale auto-parts request.
- [OE number guide](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/blog/why-oe-number-matters-for-auto-light-replacement): Understand why OE references matter for fitment checks.
- [LHD and RHD headlight guide](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/blog/lhd-vs-rhd-headlights-what-importers-should-check): Check driving-side and beam-pattern requirements before ordering.
- [Export shipping](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/export-shipping): Review export and logistics information.
- [Packing process](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/packing-process): Review the stated packing process for fragile lighting products.
- [Quality control](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/quality-control): Review the stated quality-control process.

## Company and policies

- [About I-Pack](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/about): Company background and B2B sourcing focus.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ipackautoparts.com/privacy-policy): Website inquiry-data and privacy information.
